title: regfusionr: Registration Fusion in R
text: regfusionr package implements Wu et al. (2018)’s registration fusion methods R. provides accurate nonlinear mapping three standard coordinate systems commonly used neuroimaging: FreeSurfer fsaverage surface space (MNI305) FSL MNI152 volume space SPM Colin27 volume space use package, please cite original paper: Wu J, Ngo GH, Greve DN, Li J, T, Fischl B, Eickhoff SB, Yeo BTT. Accurate nonlinear mapping MNI volumetric FreeSurfer surface coordinate systems, Human Brain Mapping 39:3793–3808, 2018.

what: Projecting Volume Data to the fsaverage Surface
title: regfusionr: Registration Fusion in R
text: Instead mapping individual coordinates, can project entire 3D 4D volume per-vertex surface data.
code: # Project an MNI152 volume file to fsaverage surface space. # The result is stored in R memory (out_dir = NULL). input_file = system.file("extdata", "testdata",   "MNI_probMap_ants.central_sulc.nii.gz", package = "regfusionr") res = vol_to_fsaverage(input_file, template_type = 'MNI152_orig',   rf_type = 'RF_ANTs', out_dir = NULL) # res$lh: per-vertex data for the left hemisphere (numeric vector, length 163842) # res$rh: per-vertex data for the right hemisphere  # To write output files instead, specify an out_dir. out_dir = tempfile("regfusionr_output_") res = vol_to_fsaverage(input_file, template_type = 'MNI152_orig',   rf_type = 'RF_ANTs', out_type = 'curv', out_dir = out_dir) # res$lh and res$rh now contain file paths to the written curv files.

what: Projecting Surface Data to a Volume
title: regfusionr: Registration Fusion in R
text: Convert per-vertex fsaverage data (e.g., cortical thickness maps) MNI152 Colin27 volume. categorical label data, use interp = "nearest":
code: # Create synthetic per-vertex data (fsaverage: 163842 vertices per hemisphere). lh_data = rnorm(163842L, 3.0, 0.2) rh_data = rnorm(163842L, 3.0, 0.2)  # Project to MNI152 volume space using linear interpolation. # The result is kept in memory only (out_dir = NULL). res = fsaverage_to_vol(lh_data, rh_data, target_space = "FSL_MNI152",   interp = "linear", out_dir = NULL) # res$projected:   fs.volume instance with a 256x256x256 data array. # res$projected_seg: same, but right-hemisphere values incremented by 1000 #                    (useful for distinguishing hemispheres in labels). # Create synthetic label data per vertex. lh_labels = sample.int(20, size = 163842L, replace = TRUE) rh_labels = sample.int(20, size = 163842L, replace = TRUE) res = fsaverage_to_vol(lh_labels, rh_labels, target_space = "FSL_MNI152",   interp = "nearest", out_dir = NULL)

title: regfusionr: Registration Fusion in R
text: package supports two registration fusion approaches: RF-ANTs (default): Recommended ANTs similar tools used registration. Use MNI152_orig Colin27_orig templates. RF-M3Z: Recommended FreeSurfer used registration. Use MNI152_norm Colin27_norm templates. coordinate-mapping functions (mni152_coords_to_fsaverage, colin27_coords_to_fsaverage), RF-M3Z uses fallback .txt-based nearest-vertex method. RF-ANTs MNI152 combination uses faster pre-computed vertex index volume.

title: Registration Fusion in R
text: API regfusionr package consists following functions: Volume → fsaverage surface: mni152_coords_to_fsaverage(): Map MNI152 RAS coordinates fsaverage vertices coordinates. colin27_coords_to_fsaverage(): Map Colin27 RAS coordinates fsaverage vertices coordinates. vol_to_fsaverage(): Project 3D 4D data MNI152 Colin27 volume (NIFTI MGH/MGZ) fsaverage per-vertex data. fsaverage surface → volume: fsaverage_vertices_to_mni152_coords(): Map fsaverage vertex indices MNI152 RAS coordinates. fsaverage_vertices_to_colin27_coords(): Map fsaverage vertex indices Colin27 RAS coordinates. fsaverage_vertices_to_vol_coords(): General function map fsaverage vertices MNI152 Colin27 coordinates (supports template RF type combinations). fsaverage_to_vol(): Project fsaverage per-vertex data (e.g., cortical thickness maps) MNI152 Colin27 volume. Cross-template volume--volume: mni152_coords_to_colin27_coords(): Map MNI152 RAS coordinates Colin27 space (via fsaverage). colin27_coords_to_mni152_coords(): Map Colin27 RAS coordinates MNI152 space (via fsaverage). MNI305 (fsaverage) coordinate mapping: mni305_coords_to_mni152_coords(): Find closest fsaverage vertex given MNI305 coordinate return MNI152 coordinates. mni305_coords_to_colin27_coords(): , returns Colin27 coordinates. Linear method (comparison): linear_fsaverage_coords_to_MNI152_coords(): Map fsaverage (MNI305) coordinates MNI152 using linear 4×4 matrix FreeSurfer documentation. Faster less accurate.

title: Project or map per-vertex values from the fsaverage surface to the cortex voxels of an MNI volume. — fsaverage_to_vol
text: lh_input numerical vector per-vertex data left hemisphere template subject. Must contain 163842 values fsaverage template. Input fsaverage6 (40962 values) fsaverage5 (10242 values) can also used upsampled using nn_interpolate_kdtree. Automatic upsamping supported interp='linear'. rh_input numerical vector per-vertex data right hemisphere template subject. Must contain 163842 values fsaverage template. See description lh_input details. target_space character string, target template space output volume . One 'FSL_MNI152'  'SPM_Colin27'. rf_type regfusion type use, one 'RF_ANTs' 'RF_M3Z'. interp interpolation method, currently 'linear' 'nearest' supported. performance 'linear' method currently quite bad, rewritten C++ find time. out_type character string, format output files.
